result:
I would increase humanity’s capacity for empathy — the ability to genuinely understand and feel what others experience.

Many of the world’s biggest problems — conflict, inequality, cruelty, neglect — are worsened by an inability or unwillingness to see other people as fully real. If people could more deeply understand one another’s pain, hopes, and perspectives, I think cooperation, justice, and kindness would become much easier to build.
